title: Wet prescribed-qbot timestep envelope
question: Can the three analytically nonconvergent wet prescribed-qbot cases be brought inside the existing Reference Richards convergence envelope by timestep reduction, without changing solver tolerances, iteration limits or the adaptive representation?
selection_rule: Select the largest prospectively tested step duration at which all three analytical reference cases converge and all three adaptive cases pass the unchanged F-AHL21 fidelity and nonlinear-path gates.
